purpose: Teach: 欠く/相応しい/熟成/建国/伝播/正論/覚醒/呈し

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、論文、欠くべからざる視点、よく、取り入れていますね、研究の深さ、本当に、印象的でした、本当に。
lines.en: Ren — your paper really does incorporate essential perspectives well. The depth of your research was genuinely impressive.
lines.style: Warm, measured approval. Lean slightly forward with genuine interest. Soft emphasis on 「本当に」. The tone of a teacher who sees real effort and means the compliment.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究テーマに、相応しいタイトル、何度も、悩みながら、決めました、本当に、苦労しました、まとめる時。
lines.en: Yes. I went back and forth many times on the title to match the theme. It was really challenging to pull everything together.
lines.style: Thoughtful and earnest. Slight hesitation — he's reflecting honestly on the struggle. Modest tone, not seeking sympathy but acknowledging the weight of the work.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 歴史的考察、時間を、熟成させながら、深めていくこと、本当に、大事ですね、桜さん、本当に、見習って欲しい。
lines.en: Historical perspective — allowing time to deepen understanding gradually — that's really vital. Sakura should be taking notes from this, honestly.
lines.style: Reflective teacher voice. A gentle observation that carries mild criticism of another student. Steady pace, genuine interest in the intellectual work. The word 「見習って」carries light weight.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。日本の建国神話、当時の文化、深く、影響を、与えていました、論文で、扱いました、本当に、深い研究、できました。
lines.en: Yes. Japan's founding myths and the culture of that era had deep influence — I explored that extensively in the paper. It was genuinely rich research.
lines.style: Quiet confidence now. He's found his footing. Slightly more tempo than before. Pride in the work, but still respectful — not boasting, just truthfully accounting for what he did.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 仏教の伝播、東アジア全体に、与えた影響、本当に、大きいですね、研究の余地、まだまだ、ありますね、ご存知ですよね。
lines.en: Buddhism's transmission and its influence across East Asia — that's really significant, isn't it. There's still so much room for research there, as you probably know.
lines.style: Engaged, gently probing. The teacher is opening doors, not lecturing. Slight lilt on the questions — she's genuinely curious where he'll go next. Warm but intellectually sharp.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。正論ばかりでは、心、動かない、と、論文の結論で、扱いました、人々の感情、本当に、大事ですね、社会で。
lines.en: Yes. I actually addressed in my conclusion that pure logic doesn't move the heart — people's emotions are vital to understanding society.
lines.style: Ren speaking with real conviction now. Slightly faster tempo — he's found something he believes in. The words come from genuine thinking, not formula. Not defensive, just sure.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 近代、覚醒を、迫られた人々の物語、論文で、丁寧に、論じていますね、本当に、感動的でした、私、読んで。
lines.en: The story of people forced to awaken during modernity — you explored that really carefully in your paper. I found it genuinely moving when I read it.
lines.style: Slower, more deliberate. The teacher has been struck by something. Soft, sincere delivery. The personal admission 「私、読んで」is gentle and honest, no distance.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。社会が、不安を、呈し始めた時期、戦時下、文学にも、影響を、与えました、本当に、深いです、研究、本当に。
lines.en: Yes. During the period when society itself was experiencing anxiety — wartime — that anxiety seeped into literature too. The research goes really deep.
lines.style: Ren at full thoughtfulness now. Patient, thorough speech. He's not rushing. The repetition of 「本当に」is natural, reflective — he's thinking as he speaks about the weight of what he studied.
